name: share-dialog
title: Share Dialog
description: Share one item — invite people and teams with one access level, people with access and why, the item's space access, and a view-only public link behind a Publish switch; a Dialog on wide screens, a bottom Sheet on phones.

meta.whenToUse: Share a record, page or meeting with people and teams, set its space access and publish it to the web — canManage gates access changes and canPublish the Publish tab.
meta.whenNotToUse: Manage a space's or team's members as a page — compose DataList with PeopleInput and PermissionMenu.
